author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
The new Reach gaming mat lets you play Big Team Battles on the planet where the UNSC suffered their most infamous defeat. Coinciding with Mantic announcing the Grunts, Jackals and UNSC Marines for Flashpoint, it's time to move the game into bigger more glorious battles! 

Thanks to Mantic for the complimentary copy of the mat to review.
